name: fdl-brazil-rl-gyms
description: Frontier Data Lead sourcing in Brazil — RL Gyms kit. Targeting engineers who build post-training, RL, eval, and coding agent infrastructure for frontier AI labs.
filter_notes: Field of Study = Computer Science is optional — add only if a string produces excessive noise from non-technical profiles. No seniority filters. No other filters ever.

archetypes.name: Lab Post-Training Engineer
archetypes.description: Engineers at frontier labs or AI companies working on RLHF, DPO, PPO, constitutional AI, or other post-training alignment methods. They build the systems that improve model behavior after pre-training.
strong_signals: Published research on alignment or post-training methods
Worked on post-training at a frontier lab (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind, Meta AI)
moderate_signals: ML infrastructure at an AI-focused company
Experience with preference optimization or human feedback systems
Work on model safety or alignment tooling

archetypes.name: Agent Builder
archetypes.description: Engineers building autonomous coding agents, tool-use systems, or agentic frameworks. They create systems where LLMs take actions, not just generate text.
strong_signals: Mentions SWE-Bench or coding agent benchmarks
Built autonomous coding agents or copilot systems
Worked on agent scaffolding at an AI lab
moderate_signals: LLM application development with agent patterns
Prompt engineering infrastructure (not just prompt writing)
Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (LangChain, AutoGPT, CrewAI at an infrastructure level)
Built systems where LLMs interact with external tools or APIs

archetypes.name: RL Infrastructure Engineer
archetypes.description: Engineers building the training infrastructure and environments for reinforcement learning. They create the gyms, simulators, and distributed training systems that RL research depends on.
strong_signals: Built or maintained RL training infrastructure
Developed custom gym environments or simulators
Experience with PPO/GRPO/REINFORCE at an infrastructure level
moderate_signals: Distributed ML training infrastructure (not RL-specific but transferable)
Simulation or environment development for any ML application
GPU cluster management for training runs

archetypes.name: Eval & Benchmark Specialist
archetypes.description: Engineers building evaluation infrastructure, benchmarks, and quality measurement systems for LLMs or coding systems. They define and measure what 'good' looks like.
strong_signals: Built LLM evaluation frameworks or harnesses
Evaluation infrastructure at a frontier lab or AI company
Experience with red-teaming or adversarial evaluation
moderate_signals: Metrics and measurement systems for AI quality
Data quality pipelines that feed into model evaluation

noise_population.name: Data Annotators / RLHF Labelers
noise_population.description: People who perform RLHF labeling, data annotation, or quality review work but do NOT build the systems. The target role is for engineers who BUILD the infrastructure that annotators use. This is the single most common source of false positives in Brazil searches for frontier AI roles.
signals: Titles: AI Trainer, Quality Reviewer, Data Analyst, Content Evaluator, Prompt Writer, AI Rater
Employment at pure annotation shops: Scale AI (labeling division), Outlier AI, Invisible Technologies, Appen, Remotasks, Surge AI, Labelbox (labeling side)
Work described as rating, labeling, reviewing, or evaluating model outputs without engineering context
No evidence of building systems, writing production code, or designing infrastructure

known_noise_patterns.collision: Centro de Aprendizagem Industrial — Brazilian vocational/industrial training centers
known_noise_patterns.action: Remove from string when it dominates results

known_noise_patterns.collision: Corporate L&D and training professionals when written as two unhyphenated words
known_noise_patterns.action: Only use hyphenated 'post-training' in strings. If the kit string has it unhyphenated, add quotes or hyphenate before pasting.

known_noise_patterns.collision: Data Protection Officer under Brazil's LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados)
known_noise_patterns.action: CS filter mitigates but doesn't eliminate. Review DPO-matching profiles carefully for context.

known_noise_patterns.collision: Initial Public Offering — matches finance professionals
known_noise_patterns.action: Skip string entirely when IPO is the primary matching term

known_noise_patterns.collision: Object-Relational Mapping — common web development term in Brazil's large web dev community
known_noise_patterns.action: Check context. If results are dominated by web devs, remove ORM from string.

save_instructions.method: Click 'Save to pipeline' button directly on the candidate's profile card or profile page
save_instructions.notes: Do NOT use the dropdown arrow next to 'Save to pipeline' or try to select a stage. Just click the main button.
save_instructions.greenhouse_rule: Save every qualifying candidate to this project regardless of Greenhouse status, prior projects, messages, or engagement history. Different projects serve different roles.

hard_skips: Annotation/labeling companies: Outlier, Appen, Scale AI labeling division, Telus International AI Data. Title patterns: AI Trainer, Quality Reviewer, Data Annotator.
RPA engineers and cloud architects whose AI is marketing language.
Current Turing employees — do not save, but note them in your report.
